title: Flamenco pur sang
text:
An indescribable experience.
So pure, so intense, so professional but above all so warm.
What a fantastic group:
singer, dancer, guitarists and an insanely good dancer!
A small company that radiates intense pleasure during their performance.
In our case, it took more than 45 minutes.
Who flew in like we'd arrived.
The setting is living room-like. 
The audience consisted of a maximum of 20 people, sitting around the spectacle.
With a free drink and a 1st place it became an unmatchable experience for us.
More or less stunned, we walked back to our car, unable to articulate to each other what we
author: 908freekl

title: Flamenco Esensa Muy bien
text: Authentic flamenco with good explanations so that I can now understand and appreciate more of it. The location was in a pub/café in a working class neighbourhood and that fitted very well
author: Monique S

title: Authentic and incredible show!
text: Speechless!!! The best hours dancing we have ever seen. From start to finish this was the most professionally run experience we have ever booked. Great communication beforehand, lovely welcome, great value for money and the most wonderful authentic setting and dancers! The highlight of our stay in Seville. Brought me to tears.
author: emilytE6157VP

title: Well worth going to this intimate and varied show!
text: What a great show! A big variety of different performances with explanations in English and Spanish, in a really intimate atmosphere. I absolutely loved the energy and talent of the group, the setting, the atmosphere, and how open they are to answering all your questions! In addition, I had a nice red wine and salmorejo while I was there. Highly recommend this experience, it's much more personal than going to a big show, and you learn a lot too.
author: Tourist03906851559

title: Great Fun enjoying and Learning about Flamenco in an Intimate Setting
text: Fun evening enjoying Flamenco and learning about its history.  Intimate atmosphere enhanced the experience.  I arrived about 15 minutes early and was able to get a seat right up front.  I was there alone but immediately met a couple of Dutch women with whom I enjoyed a pleasant walk back across the river and shared a nice dinner out.
author: ChipRosenthal

title: Thrilling
text:
It was an outstanding experience. Thank you very much. I have been there 3 times.
My friends and I enjoyed it so much. And I will come back.
author: 749a_chal

title: completely impressive
text: It was very interesting and intensive, emotional and full of tension....the dancers and singer completely captivated us
author: Destination141433

title: True Flamenco
text: Very nice, seemed really authentic, passionate and was a lot of fun. The  dancers also spoke excellent English and explained about backgrounds. Not too much, bit enough and really interesting
author: Sandrad4444

title: Flamenco up close - just wow!
text: We had a wonderful evening! Starting with a super friendly guided tour with Carina through Triana, where she introduced us to the peculiarity of this district and flamenco and its deep connection to this culture. Up to the beautiful authentic and intimate flamenco experience, in a family atmosphere.  This evening will remain our highlight of our trip to Spain for a long time and can highly recommend this experience to everyone. Thank you so much!
author: B4410MCmonikas

title: Had a great night with flamenco dancer Costanza
text:
Had a great night with Flamenco dancer Costanza. She picked us up first and then few minutes walk to a small tapas restaurant. Watched a good show there with passionate flamenco dancer Costanza, her partner, a singer and guitarist. All four very, very good. They had a lot of fun with each other and the passion burst out of them. 
Asked Costanza which tapas were good so also eaten well. Glass of wine and very successful evening. Highly recommended!
author: 595patriciap
